title: Encountered backfill data we don't recognise: 21 1 127
symptom: When starting a new sensor, Sensor Status shows 'Sensor Failed 6' and logs continually show 'Encountered backfill data we don't recognise: 21 1 127'. xDrip keeps asking for calibrations which aren't accepted and prompt the same log error.
cause: In one case, the cause was mechanical: the sensing element was not introduced under the skin; it was still stuck in the inserter. In another case, a fresh new sensor resolved the issue, suggesting the sensor itself was faulty.
fix: Replace the sensor with a fresh new one. In one case, the issue resolved on its own after ignoring it overnight.
evidence_quote: In my case (September 12th) the cause of the error was mechanical - when peeling the sensor off after 24 hours, I found that no sensing element was present. It had not been introduced under the skin! Instead, it was still stuck in the white inserter contraption.
